page.overview:
Who is Ultana Anya?

Ultana Anya was a female newscaster who worked at the Coruscant News Desk during the Clone Wars.

In 22 BBY, Anya relayed news about a live press conference held by the Republic Navy, regarding another attack by the Confederacy of Independent Systems' mysterious new weapon.
